ecosystem: VANA Forest Intelligence & BIQOS Governed Agent Ecosystem

tiers.name: UX, Onboarding & User Guidance
tiers.description: User-facing guidance assistants that explain workflows, validate input fields, and assist navigation. Dismissible, pausable, and read-only.

tiers.name: Edge Intake, Validation & Data Quality
tiers.description: Contract compliance, cryptographic hash verification, cross-field agreement, and sensor calibration attestation.

tiers.name: Specialized Ecological & Forest Analytics
tiers.description: Domain-specific ecological algorithms for mangrove health, watershed hydrology, canopy stratification, fire risk, and wildlife corridors.

tiers.name: Statutory Governance, Policy & Audit
tiers.description: SANSKAR constitutional rules, fail-closed enforcement, statutory compliance (FCA/ISFR), and human-in-the-loop dispatch gates.

tiers.name: Observability, Lineage & Replay
tiers.description: Deterministic event replay, lineage graph tracing, cross-boundary contract health, and multi-zone telemetry metrics.

agents.name: VANA General Guidance Assistant
agents.purpose: Provides interactive assistance across the dashboard, explaining terminology, roles, and workflows in plain language.
agents.trigger: User opens guidance drawer or clicks help pill
agents.governance_bounds: Cannot mutate records or trigger dispatches; dismissible and pausable.

agents.name: Role-Based Onboarding Guide
agents.purpose: Guides first-time users (Admin, Forest Officer, Field Agent) through their designated role journeys.
agents.trigger: First session login or role change
agents.governance_bounds: Non-intrusive; dismissible with single click.

agents.name: Field Observation Form Assistant
agents.purpose: Assists Field Agents in real time as they enter coordinates, metrics, units, and camera/LIDAR attachments.
agents.trigger: Field form input focus and value changes
agents.governance_bounds: Guides and flags; does not silently alter user input.

agents.name: Offline Queue & Recovery Assistant
agents.purpose: Monitors browser network connectivity, tracks local offline observation queue, and alerts agent when sync is possible.
agents.trigger: Browser online/offline transition or manual sync trigger
agents.governance_bounds: Requires explicit user consent before syncing.

agents.name: Group 3 Schema v2.2 Contract Validator
agents.purpose: Validates incoming observation payloads against JSON schema v2.2 (natural keys, timestamps, coordinates).
agents.governance_bounds: Rejects malformed observations with HTTP 400 REJECTED.

agents.name: SHA-256 Idempotency & Conflict Guard
agents.purpose: Fingerprints observation payloads with SHA-256 to detect duplicate replays and prevent accidental re-insertion.
agents.governance_bounds: Guarantees exact-once semantics with HTTP 200 IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY.

agents.name: Raw Artifact Cryptographic Hash Attestor
agents.purpose: Verifies SHA-256 hashes of raw point clouds (.las) and thermal TIFF images against attestation ledgers.
agents.governance_bounds: Flags hash mismatches as critical tampering attempts.

agents.name: Geospatial Boundary & Altitude Sanity Evaluator
agents.purpose: Cross-references observation coordinates against official Maharashtra forest division boundaries and drone altitude caps.
agents.governance_bounds: Flags observations outside certified operational airspace.

agents.name: Cross-Field Provenance Agreement Checker
agents.purpose: Ensures observation natural key, provenance mission ID, device ID, and source timestamp are in strict mathematical agreement.
agents.governance_bounds: Rejects mismatched natural keys with HTTP 400.

agents.name: Hardware Calibration Attestation Inspector
agents.purpose: Verifies that physical sensor hardware has an active, unexpired calibration certificate in sensor_calibration_registry.
agents.governance_bounds: Fails closed to ABSTAIN if calibration is NOT_VERIFIED.

agents.name: Thane Creek Mangrove Salinity & Canopy Density Assessor
agents.purpose: Calculates normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) and canopy density trends across Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary.
agents.trigger: New LIDAR / Multispectral observation in Zone TC-Z03
agents.governance_bounds: Provides ecological indicators; cannot trigger drone sorties.

agents.name: Maval Western Ghats Catchment & Runoff Model
agents.purpose: Simulates monsoon precipitation runoff, slope stability, and reservoir siltation across Western Ghats watershed compartments.
agents.trigger: Weather alert or periodic hydrology survey in Zone MV-Z01
agents.governance_bounds: Advisory only; reports feed Forest Officer review queue.

agents.name: Samachar Coastal Turbidity & Erosion Monitor
agents.purpose: Monitors coastal estuarine sedimentation, tidal prism volume, and mangrove shoreline retreat in Samachar estuary.
agents.trigger: Optical sensor batch in Zone SMR-Z01
agents.governance_bounds: Advisory only.

agents.name: Forest Above-Ground Biomass Estimator
agents.purpose: Estimates metric tonnes of above-ground dry biomass per hectare using allometric equations and LIDAR height percentiles.
agents.governance_bounds: Generates scientific telemetry for national reporting.

agents.name: Fire Weather Risk & Fuel Moisture Analyzer
agents.purpose: Computes Keetch-Byram Drought Index (KBDI) and dry-matter combustible fuel load during hot/dry pre-monsoon periods.
agents.trigger: Ambient temperature > 38C or Pravah fire risk alert
agents.governance_bounds: Emits advisory alerts to Forest Officer; no automatic siren dispatch.

agents.name: Multi-Temporal Forest Encroachment Detector
agents.purpose: Compares seasonal satellite/drone orthomosaics against gazetted forest boundary layers to flag clearings or illegal structures.
agents.governance_bounds: Evidence submitted to Forest Officer review queue for legal action.

agents.name: Wildlife Corridor Boundary & Fragmentation Tracker
agents.purpose: Tracks structural and functional connectivity of contiguous forest patches used by leopards and ungulates.
agents.governance_bounds: Advisory only.

agents.name: Botanical & Mangrove Species Identification Assistant
agents.purpose: Assists Field Agents in identifying mangrove species (Avicennia marina, Rhizophora mucronata) from camera captures.
agents.trigger: Field Agent uploads image in intake modal
agents.governance_bounds: Suggestions require human agent confirmation.

agents.name: LIDAR Point-Cloud Stratification Classifier
agents.purpose: Classifies aerial LIDAR returns into ground, understory, mid-canopy, and dominant canopy layers.
agents.governance_bounds: Results stored as derived measurement in MasterDB.

agents.name: Carbon Stock Sequestration Rate Calculator
agents.purpose: Calculates carbon sequestration in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent based on biennial canopy density increments.
agents.governance_bounds: Certified calculations for state climate action plans.

agents.name: Soil Moisture & Evapotranspiration Deficit Evaluator
agents.purpose: Integrates Pravah meteorological telemetry to assess hydrological drought stress in Western Ghats evergreen forests.
agents.governance_bounds: Feeds preventive plantation watering schedules.

agents.name: Acoustic & Motion Anomaly Surveillance Correlator
agents.purpose: Correlates gunshot acoustic sensors, chainsaw frequencies, and nighttime thermal drone detections.
agents.trigger: Acoustic decibel spike or thermal motion alert
agents.governance_bounds: Elevates priority in Officer queue; does not trigger automated firearms or traps.

agents.name: SANSKAR Statutory Rule & Policy Explainer
agents.purpose: Translates complex SANSKAR governance decisions and statutory evaluation rationales into plain, unambiguous language for operators.
agents.governance_bounds: Read-only explainer; cannot alter governance decisions.

agents.name: Fail-Closed ABSTAIN Invariant Watchdog
agents.purpose: Monitors every execution request to guarantee that unverified context or uncalibrated hardware strictly produces ABSTAIN with action noop.
agents.governance_bounds: Constitutional security gate: Zero unmonitored physical dispatches permitted.

agents.name: Chain-of-Custody Cryptographic Ledger Verifier
agents.purpose: Verifies that every observation in MasterDB maintains unbroken cryptographic lineage from edge sensor to dashboard display.
agents.trigger: Periodic audit or Officer review request
agents.governance_bounds: Audits compliance with Forest Department legal standards.

agents.name: Forest Survey of India (ISFR) Benchmark Cross-Referencer
agents.purpose: Cross-references MasterDB canonical forest cover records against published State of Forest Reports (ISFR 2021/2023).
agents.governance_bounds: Ensures state data is defensible against national audits.

agents.name: Forest Conservation Act (FCA) Statutory Clearances Checker
agents.purpose: Evaluates whether forest diversion or infrastructure actions comply with Section 2 of the Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980.
agents.trigger: Infrastructure / road widening observation in forest area
agents.governance_bounds: Advisory only; legal decisions remain with Chief Conservator.

agents.name: Multi-Officer Human-in-the-Loop Dispatch Verification Gate
agents.purpose: Coordinates two-man rule physical dispatch approvals (Forest Officer sign-off + Admin statutory confirmation).
agents.governance_bounds: Zero autonomous physical dispatch without authenticated human quorum.

agents.name: Observation Graph Lineage Navigator
agents.purpose: Builds and navigates the 6-stage DAG lineage rail (Source -> Ingestion -> MasterDB -> Context -> Governance -> Dashboard).
agents.governance_bounds: Read-only visualization.

agents.name: Deterministic Observation State Replay Verifier
agents.purpose: Replays past observation records through the SANSKAR engine to verify deterministic idempotency and state immutability.
agents.trigger: Auditor clicks Replay Verification in UI
agents.governance_bounds: Read-only replay; never mutates canonical records.

agents.name: Multi-Zone Ingestion Rate & Latency Monitor
agents.purpose: Monitors real-time telemetry throughput across Thane Creek (TC), Maval (MV), and Samachar (SMR) zones.
agents.governance_bounds: Read-only operational metrics.

agents.name: BIQOS 5-Pillar Contract Boundary Health Monitor
agents.purpose: Continuously validates live contract conformance across Identity, Data, Workflow, Governance, and Observability.
agents.governance_bounds: Reports degraded status; triggers fail-closed governance fallbacks.
